_comment: Single source of truth for the Planning contract carried by TWO surfaces: the Kronn-launched agent prompt notice (backend/src/api/disc_prompts.rs :: build_agent_prompt / introspection_notice) and the kronn-internal MCP server `instructions` block (backend/scripts/disc-introspection-mcp.py :: initialize). A parity test on each side asserts its surface still carries every invariant below. Editing the contract means editing THIS file; the two tests then tell you which surface you forgot to update. Checks are presence-of-invariant, never textual equality across locales/surfaces. See KT-29 (0.9.2-I).

human_decides._comment: Agents may READ and PROPOSE; only a human accepts/rejects/decides a DURABLE proposal. This gates the decision, not every Planning write (unambiguous intent still applies directly).
